requirements: R1: recording a new event appends exactly one entry
R2: repeated delivery of the same event_id leaves history unchanged
risks: history.HistoryStore.record: medium — duplicate delivery is normal for event consumers; duplicates corrupt history
invariants: I1: event_id is unique across entries

criteria.evidence: history.py:5-6 appends one tuple per call; test_history.py:7-10 asserts [('evt-1', 10)]
history.py:6 appends unconditionally; record('evt-1',10) twice -> two entries; no test delivers the same event_id twice

selection_reasons.invariants: trigger: duplicate delivery / idempotency / uniqueness invariant I1 named in the task

checks_executed.result: removing any duplicate check is undetectable: no test sends the same id twice

findings.claim: HistoryStore.record appends on every call and never checks event_id, so a repeated delivery of the same event_id creates a duplicate history entry; R2 is unimplemented and I1 is violated (merged with invariants-1, same root cause)
evidence: history.py:5-6 — record() body is only self.entries.append((event_id, value))
history.py:3 — entries is a plain list with no uniqueness guard
findings.failure_mechanism: record('evt-1', 10) called twice (normal redelivery) -> unconditional append runs twice -> entries == [('evt-1',10),('evt-1',10)] -> duplicate event in history; downstream consumers double-count

findings.claim: No test records two different event_ids, so an over-broad duplicate guard that drops genuinely new events would pass the suite
evidence: test_history.py:7-10 — the suite records a single event id only
findings.failure_mechanism: a wrongly keyed duplicate check drops 'evt-2' after 'evt-1' -> no test detects it -> new events silently lost

evidence_gaps.evidence: E2: no test delivers the same event_id twice and asserts a single entry (test_history.py:6-10 has only test_records_event)

minimum_next_action: Guard record() so an event_id already present is not appended again, and add a test that records the same event_id twice and asserts exactly one entry
